task: Build Kaggle kernel package (Lane B) for CE hash-fix verification
what_happened: Four consecutive attempts to delegate the kernel-authoring lane to a fixer subagent failed before any work was produced: (1) fresh session ses_f05b65248ffevDNwzAjSubTCYd -> 'Not Found: 404 page not found'; (2) fresh session ses_f05a387d2ffeoMEpbl03T73WD7 -> 'Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media'; (3) fresh session ses_f059f2f5cffeYn11QnJdhAOUIO -> same context-limit error with a ~60% smaller prompt; (4) resume of completed session fix-1 (ses_f05effc1cffeKQRSityP1We5fH) -> 'Conversation history too large to compact - exceeds model context limit'.
root_cause: Subagent session creation/resume was unavailable: fresh spawns hit a context-limit error at bootstrap independent of prompt size (the compressed prompt failed identically), and the one reusable session had accumulated too much history to compact. The 404 on the first attempt indicates a transient platform/routing fault.
what_i_did_wrong: I retried fresh spawns three times with essentially the same approach before switching strategy; the second and third attempts should have been a single adjusted attempt followed by a fallback. I also initially misdiagnosed the kernel's sibling-file problem (assumed Kaggle uploads the whole folder for a script kernel) and shipped two broken kernel versions (v1: CompletedProcess unpack error; v2: sibling files absent at /kaggle/src) before embedding the source files as base64.
impact: Lane B was executed directly by the orchestrator instead of a specialist. No incorrect output reached the user; the kernel ultimately passed all gates. Cost: ~4 wasted dispatch attempts and 2 wasted Kaggle kernel versions.
corrective_action: When a fresh subagent spawn fails twice with the same class of error, stop retrying and either (a) resume a reusable session with a minimal prompt, or (b) execute the bounded task directly. Verify platform assumptions (e.g. what Kaggle uploads for a script kernel) against a minimal probe before building the full artifact.
